notes:
ACCESS: Direct HTTP fetch (curl_cffi impersonate=chrome) succeeded for the homepage, robots.txt, and every category page - no block encountered at any point, so tier (a) HTTP-first was used exclusively; Playwright/CDP and Claude-in-Chrome were not needed. robots.txt has no ClaudeBot/anthropic-ai/Claude-Web/general-disallow entry blocking any tier. TREE: Built from the site's own mega-menu JSON, an embedded 'catalogSlim' array found inline in the homepage HTML (https://www.ikea.com/de/de/) that mirrors the full IKEA.de category navigation with nested 'subs' arrays down to leaf category pages - this is the authoritative union of the mega-menu, since IKEA.de's mega-menu is rendered directly from this same structure. Cross-checked candidate nodes against each relevant top-level nav branch (Aufbewahrung & Schranke st001, Organizer & Ordnungshelfer st007, Textilien & Teppiche tl001, Vorhange & Rollos tl002, plus Badmoebel ba001, Babys & Kinder bc001, Geschirr & Kuechenaccessoires kt001, Putzutensilien & Waschutensilien lc001, Outdoor Moebel od001, Dekoration de001) to catch cross-listed items (e.g. laundry cabinets/bags reachable only from lc001/ba001, garden furniture covers only from od001). Given the catalog's very large depth (IKEA is a sister catalog to IKEA UK SR92), modular furniture systems under Storage (PAX/BESTA/PLATSA/SMASTAD/etc.) were recorded at the system level (one row per named system) rather than exploding into every door/panel/accessory sub-variant, per the efficiency guidance for very deep trees; the same applies to 'Wardrobes' (kleiderschraenke-19053) which was kept as a single leaf rather than its ~12 door-style sub-pages. All node names translated German to English; original slugs preserved in URLs since IKEA URLs are not user-facing category names. QTY: extracted directly from each category listing page's rendered product-count element, regex-matched pattern '...>NNN Produkte

' (e.g. '146 Produkte') - this is the exact number IKEA.de displays at the top of the product grid, not paginated or estimated. Fetched via 8-way concurrent HTTP requests; every one of the 77 textile leaves and 93 storage leaves (rows total incl. groups) returned a valid count with no failures, no manual-review fallbacks needed for quantity. EXCLUDED (checked, not included): curtain rods/rails/hardware (Vorhangstangen und -schienen), window film (Fensterfolien), Venetian/slat blinds (Jalousien - not fabric), rug anti-slip pads (Gleitschutz), sewing notions (Naehzubehoer), apparel/clothing node (Kleidung & Accessoires under Textilien), picture ledges (Bilderleisten - Wall Decor), pinboards (Pinnwaende - not a container), nightstands/dressing tables (Furniture), kitchen cabinet interior fittings under the Kuechenmoebel/METOD furniture system (cutlery inserts, drawer organizers under ka001 - treated as kitchen-furniture fittings tied to the METOD/ENHET systems, not an independent Storage category, to avoid overlap with the already-validated Kitchen_and_Dining/Furniture files), pedal bins/soap dispensers/toothbrush holders/toilet accessories (waste/hygiene, not storage), water bottles/thermo mugs/cool bags (drinkware/travel, not home storage), washing machines/dryers/irons/ironing boards/dish racks/cleaning tools (appliances/cleaning tools per explicit rule exclusion), all bathroom fixtures/mirrors/lighting/taps under Badmoebel ba001. Two duplicate-URL nodes (Waeschekoerbe / laundry cabinets) reachable from both Putzutensilien lc001 and Badmoebel ba001 were recorded once only. LOW-CONFIDENCE flags: Lumbar Cushions (Lordosenstuetzen) - could be a wellness/support product rather than a home-textile cushion; Cable Management & Workspace Accessories - borderline storage/organization utility.
